page.overview:
Who is Iron Master?

The Iron Master is a character in the promotional comics/media from Hasbro.

The Iron Master is a Swords Smith and Master in the Arashikage Clan. He trained Tiger Claw and also Zartan.

The Iron Master was the Sword Brother of The Black Dragon, before The Black Dragon turned evil.

The Iron Master is the narrator of both the Ninja Battles movie and comic.
